description: What the OMOP testbed expects of the invented world's conversion, written from each step's own statement of what one row stands for. A step that is not listed below writes at most one row for each row of the table it starts from.

several_rows_for_one_source_row.measurement_blood_pressure_through_anaes: each accepted charted pressure gives two rows, one systolic and one diastolic.
several_rows_for_one_source_row.measurement_blood_pressure.sql: each accepted charted pressure gives two rows, one systolic and one diastolic.
several_rows_for_one_source_row.anaesthetic_phase.sql: each anaesthetic may have several phases, each of which is a row.
